nodes.description: Payable owner address set to msg.sender in constructor; used as the beneficiary of selfdestruct in kill().
AddressConfig instance holding all system contract addresses (token, lockup, propertyGroup, allocator, metricsGroup).
Address of the EternalStorage contract that persists all protocol state.
Owner of the EternalStorage contract, initialized to msg.sender; gates all setter/delete functions via onlyCurrentOwner.
Mapping of account balances mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Roles.Role set of accounts allowed to mint new DEV tokens.
Address of the mintable DEV token used by withdraw() to mint holder rewards.
External entry point that validates the property, computes the withdrawable reward, updates storage, mints tokens via external call and invokes lockup.update().
External hook called by the Allocator before ownership ratio changes; validates caller and re-bases pending rewards of both parties.
Private view computing a user's reward as (holdersPrice - lastCumulativeHoldersReward) * balance adjusted by Decimals.
Private view combining computed reward, pending withdrawal and legacy pre-DIP4 reward, short-circuiting to 0 when the property has no metrics.
External view wrapper around _calculateWithdrawableAmount.
Private view computing the legacy pre-DIP4 reward from the recorded cumulative price gap times user balance.
Public function that requires msg.sender == _owner and then destroys the contract, forwarding the balance to the owner.
Internal token transfer that validates addresses and updates both balances with SafeMath.
Internal mint increasing _totalSupply and the recipient balance, guarded only by a zero-address check.
Internal burn decreasing the account balance and _totalSupply with SafeMath.
Public mint restricted by onlyMinter; delegates to ERC20._mint and returns true.
Public function guarded by onlyMinter that grants the Minter role to an arbitrary account.
Public function that removes the Minter role from msg.sender.
onlyOwner function transferring contract ownership to a new address.
onlyOwner function renouncing ownership by setting the owner to address(0).
External function that requires msg.sender == currentOwner and replaces the storage owner.
onlyCurrentOwner setter writing a uint256 value into the keyed storage mapping.
onlyOwner function deploying a new EternalStorage and assigning its address.
onlyOwner function assigning an already deployed EternalStorage address.
External function that sets the Policy address after validating msg.sender equals policyFactory via the AddressValidator.
External view returning the cumulative holders amount from lockup.difference adjusted to 10^18.
onlyOwner migration helper writing an initial last cumulative holders reward into storage.
External lockup update recalculating reward state after total supply changes.
External lockup view returning holder and interest reward components for a property.
Caller address used as the reward recipient and storage key user in withdraw() and beforeBalanceChange().
Caller address compared against _owner before selfdestruct.
Caller address compared against config policyFactory in AddressConfig.setPolicy.
selfdestruct(_owner) destroys the contract and forwards the whole balance to the owner address.
External call erc20.mint(msg.sender, value) executed inside withdraw(), minting new tokens to the caller.
External call lockup.update() executed inside withdraw() after the mint and after storage writes.
Arithmetic _holdersPrice.sub(_last).mul(balance) in _calculateAmount, protected by SafeMath and divBasis.
Arithmetic priceGap.mul(balance) in __legacyWithdrawableAmount, protected by SafeMath and divBasis.
Arithmetic _totalSupply.add(amount) and _balances[account].add(amount) in ERC20._mint using SafeMath.
External staticcall addressValidator().validateAddress(msg.sender, policyFactory) used as the access control primitive in setPolicy.
Property address parameter of withdraw(address _property) used as the storage key and group validation subject.
User address parameter of _calculateAmount(address _property, address _user) used to read the last cumulative reward and balance.
Local reward amount returned by _calculateWithdrawableAmount in withdraw() and passed to erc20.mint.
Local difference between current and last cumulative price in __legacyWithdrawableAmount multiplied by the user balance.
New policy address parameter of AddressConfig.setPolicy(address _addr) written into the policy state variable.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the reward recipient and storage key user when withdraw() computes and mints rewards.
beforeBalanceChange validates msg.sender against config().allocator() before re-basing pending rewards.
kill() requires msg.sender == _owner before executing selfdestruct.
setPolicy validates the untrusted caller against policyFactory before writing the policy address.
setPolicy delegates its authorization check to the external AddressValidator staticcall.
withdraw() calls _calculateWithdrawableAmount to obtain the withdrawable value and the latest cumulative price.
The computed value flows into the external token mint call inside withdraw().
withdraw() performs an external lockup.update() call after storage writes and after minting, with no reentrancy guard.
The external erc20.mint call re-enters the token contract, whose mint function is onlyMinter restricted.
The external lockup.update call re-enters the lockup contract while withdraw() has not yet finished its state changes.
beforeBalanceChange calls _calculateAmount for both the from and to addresses.
_calculateWithdrawableAmount calls _calculateAmount before adding pending and legacy amounts.
_calculateAmount performs subtraction and multiplication on reward prices and balances.
__legacyWithdrawableAmount multiplies the cumulative price gap by the user balance.
calculateWithdrawableAmount is a thin external wrapper around _calculateWithdrawableAmount.
calculateTotalWithdrawableAmount reads the cumulative holders amount from ILegacyLockup.difference.
_calculateAmount reaches ILegacyLockup.difference through the external lockup contract call.
ERC20Mintable.mint delegates token creation to ERC20._mint.
_mint adds the minted amount to _totalSupply and to the recipient balance.
_mint increases the recipient entry of _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_transfer subtracts from the sender and adds to the recipient in _balances.
_burn decreases the account entry of _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
kill() executes the selfdestruct operation only after the owner check passes.
kill() reads _owner both for the caller check and as the selfdestruct beneficiary.
addMinter adds an account to the _minters role set if the caller already has the role.
renounceMinter removes msg.sender from the _minters role set.
setUint is gated by onlyCurrentOwner, which reads currentOwner.
setUint writes through the eternalStorage() instance resolved from _storage.
createStorage deploys a new EternalStorage and overwrites _storage, onlyOwner.
setStorage overwrites _storage with an arbitrary address, onlyOwner.
changeOwner replaces currentOwner after verifying msg.sender is the current owner.
__initLastWithdraw is onlyOwner and persists migration values through the storage contract.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and reassigns the owner state variable.
The _property parameter of withdraw is validated against propertyGroup and used as the storage key.
The _user parameter of _calculateAmount selects the last cumulative reward and the token balance.
The local reward value is the amount passed into the external erc20.mint call.
The local priceGap is the operand multiplied by the user balance in the legacy calculation.
The _addr parameter of setPolicy is written into the policy state variable after authorization.

normalization_plan.reason: The _property address parameter only exists to key storage and validate the property group inside withdraw(), so it collapses into the withdraw function node.
The _user address parameter is a transient lookup key for reward and balance reads inside _calculateAmount and carries no standalone semantics.
The local reward value is derived purely from _calculateWithdrawableAmount and is consumed directly by the external mint call.
The local priceGap is immediately multiplied by the balance, so it merges into the legacy arithmetic unsafe operation.
The _addr parameter is only assigned to the policy state variable after the caller validation inside setPolicy, so it merges into that function.
